note: 1st-year MA-111 assignments are the real assignment PDFs. Years 2–4 assignments are samples for the demo.

assignments.title: Assignment 1 · Unit 1: Introduction to Linear Algebra
assignments.details: 26 questions in three parts. Part A (Q1–Q10): matrices and their order, matrix operations, equivalent and elementary matrices, row-echelon form, Gauss–Jordan reduction, inverse of a matrix, linear dependence, rank, and systems of linear equations. Part B (Q11–Q18): longer problems on row reduction, inverse by Gauss–Jordan, linear independence with a parameter k, rank, and consistency of systems. Part C (Q19–Q26): conceptual and reasoning questions on rank, consistency and infinitely many solutions.
assignments.submit: Due date and submission mode are not stated in the PDF. Confirm with your MA-111 instructor.

assignments.title: Assignment 2 · Unit II: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
assignments.details: 18 questions in three parts. Part A (Q1–Q5): characteristic equation, eigenvalues and eigenvectors of 2×2 matrices, diagonal and triangular matrices, trace and determinant properties, orthogonal vectors. Part B (Q6–Q10): 3×3 eigenvalue problems, properties of eigenvalues (A², A⁻¹, 3A, A+2I), a parameter-based question, orthogonality of eigenvectors. Part C (Q11–Q18): Cayley–Hamilton theorem, finding the inverse and higher powers with it, and conceptual questions.
assignments.submit: Due date and submission mode are not stated in the PDF. Confirm with your MA-111 instructor.

assignments.title: Assignment 3 · Unit III: Differential Calculus
assignments.details: About 27 questions in three parts. Part A (Q1–Q8): functions of two variables, limits and continuity, partial derivatives and their geometric meaning, homogeneous functions, Euler's theorem, total differentials. Part B: differentiability, composite functions and the chain rule, Jacobians, ε-δ limits, Euler's theorem extension, Taylor and Maclaurin expansions. Part C: stationary points, the second derivative test, maxima and minima with the method of undetermined multipliers, and curve tracing. (Note: question numbers 19–20 appear twice in the PDF, once in Part B and once in Part C.)
assignments.submit: Due date and submission mode are not stated in the PDF. Confirm with your MA-111 instructor.

assignments.title: Linked list implementation
assignments.details: Q1. Implement a singly linked list with insert at front, insert at end and delete by value. Q2. Implement a doubly linked list and print it forwards and backwards. Q3. Write a function to detect a cycle in a linked list. Q4. Compare array and linked list for insertion in the middle.

assignments.title: Laplace transform problem set
assignments.details: Q1. Find the Laplace transform of t·sin(2t). Q2. Find the inverse Laplace transform of 1/(s(s+1)). Q3. Solve y'' + 4y = 0, y(0)=1, y'(0)=0 using Laplace transforms. Q4. State and prove the first shifting theorem.

assignments.title: CPU scheduling simulator
assignments.details: Q1. Simulate FCFS, SJF and Round Robin scheduling for a given set of processes. Q2. Print the Gantt chart for each algorithm. Q3. Compare average waiting and turnaround times. Q4. Explain which algorithm suits interactive systems and why.

assignments.title: Normalisation exercise
assignments.details: Q1. Identify functional dependencies for the given student-course relation. Q2. Normalise the relation to 3NF. Q3. Check whether the decomposition is lossless. Q4. Write SQL to create the final tables.

assignments.title: Mid-term project report
assignments.details: Q1. Problem statement and motivation (1 page). Q2. Literature review of at least 5 papers. Q3. Methodology and system design. Q4. Progress so far and plan for the remaining semester.

assignments.title: Classification mini-project
assignments.details: Q1. Choose a public dataset and describe it. Q2. Train logistic regression and a decision tree. Q3. Report accuracy, precision and recall. Q4. Discuss which model works better and why.
